status: provisional - confirm the items in measure_on_real_parts before first print
prose: The backplane part locates on the 8 bus-footprint holes (d3.3 at A +/-20 of every slot), never on the board outline. Relative to slot 1, gen1 and r3 are identical in every copper feature; only Edge.Cuts moved 3.714 mm. So one part fits both.

The backplane part owns alignment: a U guide (fin on +N, returns in A) rising to E 15 around each slice socket, giving 6.35 mm of guided travel before the pins meet. The case owns a matching empty bus window and a tongue under the socket.

Retention: two M3 screws per slice along -E, driven from the slice's far side past the case ends, into heat-set inserts in the backplane part. The ear pads are the only E stop; the guide, not the screw, locates the slice. Every slot carries towers T1 -56.4, T2 +56.4, T3 +101.4; each format selects two.
The stand bolts to the backplane part's underside outside the PCB footprint. It never touches a case.
scope: Contract between (a) a cased slice, (b) the printed backplane part, (c) the Loaf_x004 PCB (gen1 5b8b9b9 and r3 ebf47df/7729595), and a placeholder for (d) the stand. Parts interact only through the features named here.

frame.origin_B: Centre of the slot's 10-pin row (loaf bus-footprint origin = pin centroid), on the loaf PCB top copper plane.
frame.E: Loaf PCB top-face normal, pointing away from the loaf. E=0 is the loaf top face. A slice inserts along -E.
frame.A: Along the pin row, positive toward pin 1. Loaf KiCad: A = y_B - y. Slice KiCad: A = y_B - y (pin 1 is toward the top edge on every slice).
frame.N: Slice board normal, positive toward the slice top (THT) face. N=0 is the socket contact axis. Loaf KiCad: N = -(x - x_B), i.e. +N points toward the loaf end carrying the chain-input header (J1 gen1 / J2 r3).
frame.handedness: (E, A, N) is right-handed on both boards: slice E=+x_s, A=-y_s, N=out-of-top; loaf E=out-of-top, A=-y_l, N=-x_l. Rigid motion, no mirror. Agrees with the gen-2 Loaf Support (ear holes at loaf x-11.5 from the pin row) and Pin Aligner (fin on loaf -x side).
frame.source: tools/loafparse.py, tools/sliceparse.py on the KiCad files; KiCad 3D models PinSocket_1x10_P2.54mm_Horizontal.step and PinHeader_1x10_P2.54mm_Vertical.step

slot_envelope_note: Hard rule is thickness <= 30.0. The split [-7.9, +22.1] contains the gen-2 as-built case [-7.87, +21.73]. The r3 board drawing (User.4 rects, commit 7729595) uses [-7.4, +22.6]; update it at source if this split is adopted.

slice_side_datums.sources: socket body 0..2.54 above board and mouth 10.03 from pin row: KiCad PinSocket_1x10_P2.54mm_Horizontal.step; pin row 3.6 from edge and 50.02/49.98 from the ends: sliceparse.py on 40 Slice_* boards; L long side is on +A (pin-1 side) on all 5 L boards; pin_row_E = seat_E + 6.0 from gen-2 top case (ear face x=-7.4, pin row x=-1.4).

loaf_side_datums.sources: KiCad PinHeader_1x10_P2.54mm_Vertical.step z 0..2.54, tip 8.647 (model, not the fitted part)

seat.rule: The E stop is the case ear pads on the backplane retention towers, both at seat_E. The socket then floats 0.13 above the header plastic (2.67 vs 2.54). Nothing else carries E load.
seat.case_faces: Every other case face lies at E >= seat_E + 0.3, except the socket and tongue inside the bus window.
seat.backplane_faces: Every backplane-part face lies at E <= seat_E - 0.3, except the tower top faces (= seat_E) and the guide inside the bus window.
seat.source: gen-2 Loaf Support: ear seat face z=-10.7, loaf pocket floor z=-19.0, board 1.6 -> 6.7 above loaf top (loops.py loafx04_support)

bus_edge_zone.owner: case may occupy only this below seat_E + 0.3; backplane may occupy only the guide inside it above seat_E - 0.3

case_tongue.purpose: carries insertion load off the socket solder joints (gen-2: 25.4 wide, 4.43 past board edge)

case_bus_window.rule: kept empty in the case so the backplane guide can enter. On the slice board this is a top-side keep-out: within 6.4 of the bus edge and |A| <= 15.4, only the bus socket.

bus_edge_zone.slice_board_keepout_check: tools/windowscan.py 6.4 15.4 over 40 boards: 1 hit, Slice_IOCT D1 (DO-41, courtyard 2.56 past the bus edge) -> named exception

alignment.feature: per-slot U guide around the slice socket body: a fin on +N and two end returns in A, open on -N
alignment.lead_in: 1.5 x 45 deg chamfer on the top inner edges of fin and returns
alignment.derivation: socket mouth reaches guide top at 15.0-2.67 = 12.33 above seat; pins enter at 8.65-2.67 = 5.98 above seat
alignment.source: gen-2 Pin Aligner: fin loaf x -5.35..-1.35, height 15 above its base (loops.py loafx04_pinalign z 26..39), reported working

retention.type: screw along -E from the slice far side, into a heat-set insert in the backplane part
retention.screw: M3 x 10 socket head (ISO 4762), 2 per slice

case_ear.hole_shape: teardrop, point toward -N (up when the THT-side part prints roof-down), 45 deg
case_ear.N_range_max_note: pad land only; buttressing beyond it is allowed inside the slot envelope at E >= seat_E + 0.3

backplane_tower.insert: M3 heat-set, hole d4.0 (the user's gen-1 pocket size), depth >= 6.5, d3.2 relief below

retention.driver_access: cylinder d7.0 on each retention axis from E = 11.7 to beyond the case far edge; no case (own or neighbour) may enter it. Within the slot's own N envelope, so packing at 30.4 never blocks it.
retention.no_loose_nuts: inserts only in the backplane part; case ears are plain clearance holes
retention.source: A +/-56.4 and N +11.5: gen-2 Loaf Support (loops.py loafx04_support z=-11: holes at u -53.2 vs bus holes -41.7; v +/-56.4). Keeping them lets gen-2 cases screw into the new part and new cases into the gen-2 support.
retention.towers_note: Every slot carries all towers, at point_N. Formats select towers by id (bread-infra format table). Guidance for a new format: ear 6.4 beyond the board end, i.e. pick or add the tower there.

backplane_to_loaf_pcb.locate_and_fasten: 8 x NPTH d3.3 per loaf at A = +/-20, N = 0 of every slot; M3 x 6 from the loaf underside into heat-set inserts in the backplane part (bosses d8 at the holes, top <= 6.4)
backplane_to_loaf_pcb.identical_in_both_revs_relative_to_slot1: bus footprints, d3.3 holes, barrel jack, chain-connector pin rows and all top-side THT pads; only Edge.Cuts moved (3.714)

loaf_bottom_keepouts.what: barrel jack body, plug enters from -A edge
J1/J2 chain-input header, past the outline
J6/J7 chain-output socket, past the outline

backplane_to_loaf_pcb.print: whole backplane part at E >= 0, printed on its E=0 face, no supports; underside inserts installed from that face
backplane_to_loaf_pcb.sources: tools/loafkeepout.py and tools/thtpads.py on git show <rev>:hardware/BREAD_Loaf.kicad_pcb; heights from KiCad 3D models (jack 9.0, headers 2.54, tails 3.3)

stand.attaches_to: backplane part only, never the case or the loaf PCB
stand.face: backplane E=0 face outside the PCB union footprint (|A| >= 25.5 or u outside [-23.0, 102.6])
stand.fastening: M3 from the stand side into heat-set inserts in the backplane part; pattern TBD
stand.must_clear: loaf_bottom_keepouts; barrel-jack plug path along +A at u 9.6..21.6; chain connectors at both ends

measure_on_real_parts: Loaf PCB: header plastic height and pin tip above the board top. Model values are 2.54 and 8.65; the 0.13 float and the 6.35 guided travel depend on them.
Slice: socket centreline above the board top. The model gives 1.27; it sets board_top_N.
Gen-2 support with the loaf fitted: ear-seat face to loaf top. The STL gives 6.7 if the board rests on the z=-19 face.
Gen-2 assembled slice in the support: socket mouth to header plastic gap. It should be about 0.1 if seat_E = 6.7 is right.
Gen-2 case: ear-hole centre to slice board top, in N. Expect 11.5 + 1.27 = 12.77; the STL frame gives 13.0. This settles N 11.5 versus 11.7.
Gen-2 support: does an r3 board drop in? The hole pattern matches; the outline extends 3.71 further at the slot-1 end.
Gen-2 aligner: confirm the 2.0 x 26.5 underside groove at +3.7 clears the J6/J7 tails at slot 4, and measure the tail height (model 3.3).
Gen-2 case outline in A (104.8 from STL): confirm the ears clear neighbours and a long 2.5 mm hex key reaches the ear heads from the far side with 4 slices packed.
changes_from_v1: retention: a fixed tower set (T1 -56.4, T2 +56.4, T3 +101.4) is the slot contract; a format row in the format table selects towers by id. Removes retention.points_A per format, rule_A as a rule, towers_per_slot as 'union of formats', and slice_side_datums.format_extent_A. A new format that needs a new tower position is a backplane reprint, and the format table says so by naming an unknown id.
retention.case_ear.hole_d 3.4 -> 3.8, printed as a teardrop: the guide sets the slice position; the screw only clamps (M3 in 3.8 leaves +/-0.4, larger than the guide's 0.15/0.2 clearance).
retention.case_ear.N_range_max describes the pad land only; a case may buttress the ear further in N inside its own slot envelope at E >= seat_E + 0.3.

slice_side_datums.board_thickness -> board_thickness_range [1.4, 1.8]: board_top_N is the datum (socket sits on it); the board's underside floats with thickness, and a case must absorb that inside the envelope.
named_exceptions_moved_to: format table exceptions list (bread-infra stand-in: synth/formats.yaml)
